title: Unicode-aware weighted prefix suggestions
prompt:
Repair solve(payload). Input has entries ([{"text":string,"count":positive_integer}]), prefix (string),
and k (nonnegative integer). Aggregate counts only for exactly identical original text. Keep entries
whose text.casefold() starts with prefix.casefold(). Rank by aggregate count descending, then folded
text ascending, then original text ascending using Python string ordering. Return at most k records
{"text": original_text, "count": aggregate}. Different original spellings remain distinct even when
their folded forms match. Use Unicode casefold, not lower, and perform no Unicode normalization.
Empty text/prefix are valid; empty prefix matches all entries. Return [] when k is zero or no match.

Do not mutate the input. Use only Python's standard library.

Public examples:
- Input: `{"entries": [{"text": "apple", "count": 2}, {"text": "apricot", "count": 4}, {"text": "banana", "count": 8}], "prefix": "ap", "k": 2}`; output: `[{"text": "apricot", "count": 4}, {"text": "apple", "count": 2}]`.
- Input: `{"entries": [{"text": "Alpha", "count": 1}], "prefix": "AL", "k": 3}`; output: `[{"text": "Alpha", "count": 1}]`.

files.public_tests.py:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only
import copy
import json
import unittest
from solution import solve

CASES = json.loads('[{"name": "rank", "input": {"entries": [{"text": "apple", "count": 2}, {"text": "apricot", "count": 4}, {"text": "banana", "count": 8}], "prefix": "ap", "k": 2}, "expected": [{"text": "apricot", "count": 4}, {"text": "apple", "count": 2}]}, {"name": "case", "input": {"entries": [{"text": "Alpha", "count": 1}], "prefix": "AL", "k": 3}, "expected": [{"text": "Alpha", "count": 1}]}]')

class PublicExamples(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_examples(self):
        for item in CASES:
            with self.subTest(name=item["name"]):
                value = copy.deepcopy(item["input"])
                self.assertEqual(solve(value), item["expected"])
                self.assertEqual(value, item["input"], "solve must not mutate its input")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
